title: A measure grouped by a dimension column sums the related fact rows
query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Product[Color], "Amount", [Sales Amount] ) ORDER BY Product[Color]

source.quote: If all expressions evaluate to BLANK for a row, that row is not included in the table returned.
source.supports: SUMMARIZECOLUMNS groups by the column and leaves out a group whose only expression is BLANK (Green)

derivation: Red products are Bike (1) and Helmet (2): Sales rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 = 100 + 40 + 20 + 200 + 100 = 460. Blue is Lock (3): rows 4, 6 = 50 + 30 = 80. Green (Scooter) has no sales: its measure is BLANK, so SUMMARIZECOLUMNS drops the row. SUM of a fixed decimal column is a fixed decimal.
